diagnostic.causal_inputs: Execution classification uses observed fill information, not an available pre-execution decision signal. Future quotes are confined to outcomes. Strict-prior event timestamps do not establish local pre-execution availability; the proposal acknowledges this limitation. Conditioning on side and pre-event context can test a conditional association but cannot by itself identify a causal inventory effect, trader intent or order-placement policy.
diagnostic.evidence_limits: References, hashes and reported coverage were not independently verified. The packet's favorable label is not accepted as causal evidence.
diagnostic.fidelity: The proposal accurately distinguishes pooled event-time group medians, unequal day portions, maker context and REST-receipt outcomes. It correctly states that the historical summary cannot establish a historical position-effect markout association.
missing_requirements: Existing-window event-level fill, order, position-effect and quote joins with provenance.
Pre-event market-context measurements and explicit clock-alignment, freshness and gap handling.
An explicit conditional comparison method and treatment of order dependence, temporal clustering and overlapping outcomes before confirmatory interpretation.
A separate prospective evaluation of this now-articulated conditional hypothesis; further analysis of the already inspected window remains exploratory.
diagnostic.optional_spec_review: Neither executable_spec nor experiment_profile is supplied. Execution compatibility is therefore not established. Claims about adapter capabilities and unsupported strategy types are unverified observations, not grounds to reject this non-executable study.
diagnostic.parameter_evidence: The 60-second horizon is grounded in the pilot question and supplied measurements. Freshness thresholds are reported sensitivity settings, not independently validated parameters. No executable sizing, exposure or execution parameters are inferred.
diagnostic.scope: Consistent as a descriptive, falsifiable research hypothesis requiring further evaluation, not as an identified causal effect or proof of an advantage.
diagnostic.testability: The proposed conditional contrasts are testable in principle with the requested event-level joins. Aggregate medians alone cannot support those contrasts, recover the combined comparator, or quantify clustered variation. Clustering and overlapping outcomes must remain explicit in interpretation.
